articles.title: A study of 77 Bronze Age children in Serbia found sex-linked burial customs dating back 4,000 years
articles.description: The study of burial practices in Bronze Age Serbia indicates that children’s funerary treatment varied by biological sex, with research focused on two Maros culture cemeteries. Boys and girls were interred in contrasting ways, highlighting established gender roles. Interestingly, some burials challenged these customs, inviting reflection on societal standards. This work sheds light on the nuances of how ancient communities perceived and enacted gender distinctions in funerary rituals.

articles.title: In 1997, Australia eradicated rabbits to save Gould’s petrels; by 2000, 800 pairs bred on the island
articles.description: After the successful elimination of rabbits from Cabbage Tree Island, conservationists observed a remarkable increase in the Gould’s petrel population. This pivotal action mitigated serious threats to their habitat and reproductive success, leading to over 800 breeding pairs by 2000, with annual offspring exceeding 400. To further bolster the species, a second breeding colony was initiated on Boondelbah Island, emphasizing the need for ongoing protective measures.

articles.title: Kelly Clarkson’s late ex-husband bought this luxury Montana estate in 2022 and lived there after the couple split; less than a year after his death, the property is now listed for $2.9 million
articles.description: Brandon Blackstock's expansive 40-acre estate in Montana has hit the market for an impressive $2.9 million. Spanning over 6,400 square feet, the lodge boasts four spacious bedrooms alongside a fully equipped equestrian complex. Acquired following his split from Kelly Clarkson in 2020, the estate symbolizes significant lifestyle changes. Tragically, Blackstock passed away in August 2025 after a prolonged battle with cancer.
